subject: Renewal: 16→32 GPU uplift & throughput SLAs
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@sable-labs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal question — potential 2x capacity uplift

Neha / Karthik,

Quick note as we start planning our renewal later this quarter. Sable Labs is preparing to double our reserved GPU footprint on Redwood (16 → 32) to support a new realtime recommendation surface. Two things we need to understand before we commit:

- A rough blended per-reserved-GPU-hour price for a 12‑month commitment at 32 GPUs (we currently pay for 16).
- The throughput/latency guarantees we can expect at steady state and any SLA credit language for p99 latency misses.

High-level constraint: we need 99th percentile latency to remain under ~250ms for our 2k qps percentile mix, and we want predictable monthly spend (so please include ramp profile scenarios). Can you share an initial commercial sketch by next week?

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
VP Engineering, Sable Labs
alex.mercer@sable-labs.com

Attachments: none
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@sable-labs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal question — potential 2x capacity uplift

Alex — thanks for the clear constraints. Appreciate the heads-up. We ran a quick capacity model with the product team and put together two starter options (conservative and aggressive) plus a draft throughput SLA. See attached (rev_A_pricing_32gpu.xlsx, throughput_guarantee_draft.docx).

Summary (starter):
- Term: 12 months; committed reserved pool: 32 GPUs
- Blended reserved price (provisional): $5.25 per reserved-GPU-hour (see workbook for blended month-by-month ramp alternatives)
- Ramp options: immediate 32 GPU start; or staged (50% first 30 days → 100% by day 60)
- SLA sketch: 99th percentile latency target 230ms; if monthly p99 > 300ms then 10% of monthly committed fee as credit (draft language)

Would love to hop on a 30‑minute call with you + procurement the week of 6/28 to walk the numbers and tune ramp. I can also bring Marissa (commercial lead) if you'd like.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: rev_A_pricing_32gpu.xlsx (spreadsheet), throughput_guarantee_draft.docx (word)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-23T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal question — commercial playbook (internal)

CONFIDENTIAL — internal commercial thread (do not share outside Redwood).

Quick take after reviewing Neha's starter:
- Price banding: target $4.95–$5.10 per reserved-GPU-hour for a 12‑month 32 GPU pool. We can put $5.00 as a negotiation anchor and offer step-downs for commit length or multi-region add-ons.
- Ramp mechanics: staged ramp (50% month 1) reduces immediate cash exposure; allow 90 days to reach full pool without altering per-hour pricing.
- SLA: keep 99th p99 target at 230ms; propose explicit remediation (10% credit) capped at one month's fee per quarter.
- Commercial levers to close: one-time onboarding credit, waived data egress for first 2 months, and a 60‑day performance review to validate quantization/throughput tuning.

If you want to be aggressive, we can price to $4.85 but require a 24‑month commit; otherwise $4.95 is doable for 12 months. I'll plan to have a clean term sheet we can send to procurement after we align.

— Karthik
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: none
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@sable-labs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@sable-labs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-01T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal question — potential 2x capacity uplift

Neha / Karthik — thanks, the starter numbers are helpful. A few procurement asks before we lock a meeting: 

- Please include a Data Processing Addendum and SOC2 attestation (we run audits quarterly).
- Need a firm quote by EOD 2027-07-12 to align with our budget committee.
- Can the SLA credit be adjusted to include a remedy when p99 spikes due to infra regressions (not customer-side traffic spikes)? We want a narrow definition so the credit is actionable.

If you can get us a draft commercial term sheet and DocuSign by 7/12, we can route for signature quickly. Priya (CC) will join the call next week.

— Alex

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-13T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Final term sheet for Sable Labs (ready for customer)

Team — pulling this together for Neha to send. Final commercial suggestion to meet Sable's 7/12-ish timing (slightly delayed but within their window):

- Term: 12 months, effective on signing
- Committed pool: 32 reserved GPUs (single region, us-west)
- Blended reserved price: $4.95 per reserved-GPU-hour (applies to all hours within committed pool)
- Ramp: 50% of pool billed at full rate first 30 days; full pool after day 60. Billing follows usage of reserved pool hours, with monthly true-up.
- SLA: 99th percentile latency objective 230ms. Remedy: if monthly p99>300ms and root cause on Redwood side, credit = 10% of monthly committed fee (capped at one month's committed fee per quarter). Customer to provide traffic sample during review window.
- Add-ons: one-time onboarding credit of $15k; two months waived outbound data egress; 60-day performance review to tune quantization profiles.

Attached: Commercial_Term_Sheet_32GPU_20270713.pdf (final) and a DocuSign envelope link we will send with the term sheet. Confirm and I'll greenlight Neha to send.

— Marissa Cole
Commercial Lead — Redwood Inference
